name: Solar Prism Meadow
description: A sun‑kissed meadow where each blade of grass acts as a tiny prism, splitting sunlight into rainbow ribbons that dance across the field.
prompt: Expansive meadow at high noon, each grass blade transformed into a microscopic prism refracting sunlight into vivid spectral ribbons. The air shimmers with floating color bands. Soft focus background of distant hills. Hyper‑realistic rendering, vibrant saturated colors, 8k, cinematic depth.
caption: Walk through a rainbow with every step. 🌈☀️ #SolarPrismMeadow
